purpose: Prepare Sheikha to obtain the highest legally available corporate, advisory, regulatory-support, licensing, association, exchange, marketplace, and international institutional status through competent authorities without claiming any official authority before approval.

commercial_legal_entity.target: licensed commercial consulting and technology entity
commercial_legal_entity.authority: Ministry of Commerce and relevant competent authorities

professional_consulting_license.target: licensed advisory and consulting practice where applicable
professional_consulting_license.authority: Ministry of Commerce and sector regulators

non_profit_association_or_center.target: association, center, or nonprofit organization if suitable
non_profit_association_or_center.authority: National Center for Non-Profit Sector and related authorities

metals_exchange_or_marketplace.target: metals marketplace, commodities platform, exchange-support model, or licensed market infrastructure
metals_exchange_or_marketplace.authority: Capital Market Authority, Saudi Exchange, Ministry of Industry and Mineral Resources, and competent authorities

mining_and_minerals.target: mining, minerals, metals intelligence, trading, and compliance readiness
mining_and_minerals.authority: Ministry of Industry and Mineral Resources and related authorities

international_institutional_status.target: international partnerships, standards body participation, advisory network, or institutional representation where legally permitted
